blind.description: A stylized stone statue of a hooded, cloaked figure with arms crossed or hands tucked into wide sleeves across the chest. The figure wears long, vertically draped robes and a deep cowl that conceals the face, mounted on a square stepped plinth. The surface is smooth and continuous, finished in an aged, weathered olive-grey stone texture with darker shading in the recessed folds.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rounded shoulder mantle and the point of a cowl hood facing forward, set atop the square outline of the pedestal base.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 ft tall including the plinth), with a base roughly 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
